name: Misohagi Fumikiri de Matteru
original_name: ミソハギ踏切で待ってる
source:
On his first visit to his father's rural hometown in seven years, Hotaru reunites with his first love—only to learn that she died three years ago. Explore Yokomizo, uncover the truth behind a family tragedy, and escape supernatural otherworlds in this Japanese horror mystery adventure.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5106500/Misohagi_Crossing/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
时隔七年重返父亲的乡下老家，萤与自己的初恋少女久别重逢——却愕然得知她早在三年前便已不在人世。在这款日式恐怖悬疑解谜冒险游戏中探索横沟町，揭开一桩灭门惨剧背后的真相，并从怪异丛生的异界中逃出生天吧。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5106500/Misohagi_Crossing/]Steam[/url]]
